items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: when I joined the band they had already played these arrangements for years with Benny Moten.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. That's the reason why I quit that time. Because, you know, when I joined the band they had already played these arrangements for years with Benny Moten. You see. And I was scruffling and trying to use a little ingenuity that I did have to find a note to play an arrangement and Basie said, "Well, when you do that and you find a note tonight and it sounds good, play the same damn note tomorrow night, every night." Every night, you know.
Well, when you joined were Dicky Wells and Benny Moton there?
He wasn't in the band. Dan Minor was in the band. And -- Dan Minor, and let's see, who else? Dicky Wells
